text:
maya: Heads up — argocd app-of-apps prune wave kicked off ~08:22 and it's hanging on two gpu-pool child apps. New GPU node sets are blocked.
deploy-bot: sync started for app/gpu-pool-east (wave=4)
liam: seeing 409s from cloud-api when trying to cleanup old node groups, and several PVCs stuck Terminating with finalizers from snapshot-controller.
anita: can you paste the pod/job that's stuck? often it's a helm post-delete hook job staying Terminating.
maya: logs: `helm-delete-hook-xyz` in infra namespace stuck with "failed to remove finalizer: resource busy". PVs: pv-gpu-cache-12c stuck with finalizers: [kubernetes.io/pv-protection snapshot.storage.k8s.io/keep-backups].
sam: ugh, that finalizer combo will prevent prune. don't force remove without checking backups.
liam: quick check commands:
`kubectl get pvc -n infra -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.metadata.name|test("gpu-cache")) | {name:.metadata.name,status:.status.phase,finalizers:.metadata.finalizers}'`
`kubectl describe job -n infra helm-delete-hook-xyz`
anita: if snapshots are pending, snapshot-controller may be waiting on cloud snapshot create which failed because cloud quotas were hit. that explains 409s.
ops-oncall: immediate mitigation: pause prune waves and unfreeze app-of-apps so it stops deleting. you can set `argocd app patch <app-of-apps> -p '{"spec":{"syncPolicy":null}}'` to disable auto-sync (manual only) — then we can fix resources without churn.
maya: doing that now. also opening cloud ticket for snapshot quota.
liam: temporary manual fix I used before (do with ops): remove the snapshot finalizer after ensuring snapshot creation failed and is unrecoverable:
`kubectl patch volumesnapshot snapshot-abc -n infra -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":[]}}' --type=merge`
sam: confirm backup state before patching. if snapshot is queued, we risk losing recovery point.
anita: long term: we should avoid global prune waves that hit many clusters/apps simultaneously. suggestion: add a small stagger annotation to child apps so prune waves run in waves of 5-10s, and add a gate for PVC/pv finalizer presence.
liam: also adding argocd syncOptions to child apps: `SkipDryRunOnMissingResource` and using `PrunePropagationPolicy=Background` reduced stuck deletes in our last run.
ops-oncall: cost note — repeated create/delete of GPU node groups during ripples is burning credits. can we set a temporary quota on autoscaler to avoid churn until prune stabilizes?
maya: created a short-lived kubequota on cluster to cap scaleups to +2 nodes, will monitor.
deploy-bot: sync paused for app-of-apps by maya
sam: follow-ups: (1) add a small pre-sync job to check for stuck snapshots and failfast with message, (2) implement argocd appset plugin that staggers prune-wave via annotation, (3) add alert on PVC finalizers older than 10m.
anita: I'll open the infra GH issue with a proposed patch for appset/annotations and a playbook for safely removing snapshot finalizers.
maya: thanks — once cloud quota is cleared and I remove a couple of orphan snapshots we should be able to resume prune waves. will post updates in this thread.
liam: status 08:48 — removed 2 orphan snapshots, patched helm-delete-hook job (deleted the job object), re-enabled sync for app-of-apps. watch for new errors.
maya: 08:51 all child apps progressed, GPU pools reconciled, new node sets provisioned. marking as resolved for now, leaving follow-up tasks in GH.
ops-oncall: resolved -> monitoring for 2 hours and then re-enable autoscaler fully. :thumbsup:
